body:
The upstream is incorrect but we can at least fix our local copy.

I created a PR but I slightly changed the semantic so I would like for @michalszynkiewicz to check the PR.
@gsmet As I'm still learning the RESTEasy code base where in the upstream is this incorrect? The stack trace doesn't look like it's coming from RESTEasy at all.

@jamezp the Quarkus class is more or less a copy of the original RESTEasy one. You have the same error here: https://github.com/resteasy/Resteasy/blob/main/resteasy-client-microprofile-base/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/microprofile/client/RestClientBuilderImpl.java#L256 .

`http.nonProxyHosts` is not a regexp pattern, it uses `*` as a wildcard so it can't be treated as such.

See my proposal for a fix here: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/19261/files .

But I'm not familiar at all with this code so better wait for @michalszynkiewicz to vouch for it.
Right yeah. I'm not sure why a pattern was used there. I've filed a JIRA to get this fixed in RESTEasy https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RESTEASY-2984.

issue.title: Simplify proxy selection for the REST Client
issue.body:
- do not use regexp pattern matching for http.nonProxyHosts env variable
  given it is not supposed to be a valid regexp (* is the wildcard)
- give precedence to the builder configuration over the env variables
- delegate the whole proxy resolution via env variables to ProxySelector

Fixes #19240
Fixes #18548
